cohort: 2,131 newborns at Al-Zahra hospital in Guilan, Iran between April 2018 and March 2019
finding: Neonate resuscitation was needed in 14.1% of newborns, and the outcome was significantly associated with gestational age, meconium staining of amniotic fluid, mode of delivery, birth weight, multiple pregnancies, and Apgar score at minute 1 and 5.
mod_finding: Infants born by cesarean delivery had an 18.7% resuscitation rate.
